patthana15.30:1.1: lokiyaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokuttaro na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupapaccayā, dve.
patthana15.30:2.1: lokiyaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokuttaro na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana15.30:3.1: lokiyaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na lokiyo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, dve. kenaciviññeyyaṃ
